summary: Unpinned third-party GitHub dependency executes on install
details: package.json declares the dependency `libsignal` as `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA or tag. On `npm install`, this resolves to whatever bytes the referenced branch currently contains at that moment and runs any lifecycle scripts inside the fetched tree, with no version pin and no integrity check. The GitHub owner `RahmadTenpoles` is unrelated to the package's declared publisher/repository (`FathulGans/Raiden-Baileys`), so a third party unaffiliated with the publisher controls code that executes on every installer's machine. The source is a mutable branch rather than a registry artifact or pinned commit, so the executed code can change at any time without any change to this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
